rules.title: Santa Ana rent stabilization cap
rules.requirement: In Santa Ana, rent can go up by no more than 3% per year or 80% of the change in CPI, whichever is lower. If CPI is negative, no rent increase is allowed.
rules.requirement_es: En Santa Ana, la renta puede subir como máximo un 3% al año o el 80% del cambio en el IPC, lo que sea menor. Si el IPC es negativo, no se permite ningún aumento.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental units in Santa Ana, except buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.quote: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.

rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction
rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, a Santa Ana landlord must have a just cause listed in the law and state it in a written notice to end your tenancy. For no-fault evictions, the landlord must pay 3 months of relocation assistance or waive the last 3 months of rent.
rules.requirement_es: Después de 30 días de arrendamiento, el propietario en Santa Ana debe tener una causa justa establecida en la ley e indicarla por escrito para terminar su arrendamiento. En desalojos sin culpa, el propietario debe pagar 3 meses de asistencia de reubicación o perdonar la renta de los últimos 3 meses.
rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies in Santa Ana after 30 days, except housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.
rules.quote: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
